about: The mutant ledger of the IR build path's coverage and agreement tooling (internal/experimental/irspike and the IR builder's census in internal/sketch/lower/ir.go). Its killers need the IR toolchains or the full tier; see toolchain/ir/ports.md. The patch-level mutant port-stock-not-identical (a planted codegen change outside the -ergoir guard) is an edit of the Go patch, run with scripts/irport -patch, not here. The derivative's own IR1 mutants are recorded by name only (go-irspike, wf10 IR1 round 1): M1 the decoder swaps binary operands, M2 drops the else branch, M4 the IR path builds with bounds checks off (-B), all killed by TestIRMatchesSource; M6 the decoder accepts a type mismatch, killed by TestIRBodyThatDoesNotCheck. TestIRRuntimeChecks (race detector, GC checkmark) was deleted in batch-18 fix-tool: it guarded only the derivative's stack and pointer maps, and no mutant of this repository reached it.

mutants.name: ir-int64-as-int
mutants.rule: An IR type is spelled as the lowered Go type: int64 stays int64

mutants.name: ir-text-int-as-uint
mutants.rule: An interpolated signed integer's text is the emitter's (FormatInt: a negative value keeps its sign)

mutants.rule: A discarded value is still evaluated (its panics happen): `let _ = x` is `_ = x`

mutants.name: ir-ifexpr-arm-swapped
mutants.from: pre := []*irStmt{{K: "var", Pos: p, Local: i}, b.ifStmt(s, true, &yieldTo{local: i, t: t})}
mutants.rule: An if expression yields its then arm when the condition holds

mutants.rule: x op= y keeps its operator

mutants.name: ir-continue-as-break
mutants.rule: continue goes to the loop's next turn, it does not leave the loop (break as continue would hang the counted loops, so the ledger plants this direction)

mutants.name: ir-unnamed-param-shift
mutants.rule: An unnamed parameter keeps its slot: the parameters after it are read from their own

mutants.name: ir-try-no-propagate
mutants.from: Then: []*irStmt{{K: k, Pos: p, X: errLocal}}}
mutants.to: Then: []*irStmt{{K: k, Pos: p, X: errLocal}}[:0]}
mutants.rule: A try leaves the frame with the callee's error; it never goes on with a zero value

mutants.name: ir-catch-default-swallows
mutants.from: sw.Else = []*irStmt{{K: k, Pos: sw.ElsePos, X: &irExpr{K: "local", Pos: sw.ElsePos, I: e}}}
mutants.to: sw.Else = []*irStmt{{K: k, Pos: sw.ElsePos, X: &irExpr{K: "local", Pos: sw.ElsePos, I: e}}}[:0]
mutants.rule: A total catch's default arm panics with the error; it never returns it

mutants.name: ir-catch-else-dropped
mutants.from: ifs.Else = []*irStmt{{K: "set", Pos: sw.End, Local: result, X: val}}
mutants.to: ifs.Else = []*irStmt{{K: "set", Pos: sw.End, Local: result, X: val}}[:0]
mutants.rule: A catch with no error takes the call's value; the success branch sets the result

mutants.name: ir-spill-skipped
mutants.rule: An operand before one that runs statements is evaluated first, into a temporary (callArgs order)

mutants.name: ir-loop-poll-dropped
mutants.rule: A polling frame's loop polls the task at the end of each iteration (loopBody)

mutants.name: ir-fail-as-panic
mutants.rule: A failure return in a fallible frame fails it; it panics only in a frame that cannot fail

mutants.name: ir-catch-arm-swapped
mutants.rule: Each catch case runs its own arm's body

mutants.name: ir-env-last
mutants.rule: An impure callee takes the environment first, after a method's receiver (callText)

mutants.name: ir-hoist-skipped
mutants.rule: An effectful call in value position runs into a temporary before its expression, so it never overtakes an earlier operand (the emitter's v := f(…))

mutants.name: ir-unit-tail-dropped
mutants.rule: A body with no value whose tail is an error value fails with it (retExpr); the value is never dropped

mutants.name: ir-variant-tag-shift
mutants.rule: A variant goes into a flat union through its own of method

mutants.name: ir-narrow-zero
mutants.rule: `T as x` on a flat union reads the variant's slot, not a zero record

mutants.name: ir-tag-case-shift
mutants.rule: A match on a flat union takes each variant's case by its own tag

mutants.name: ir-arm-yield-dropped
mutants.from: return b.tailTo(list, ret && to == nil, to)
mutants.rule: A match arm yields its value: the function's result or the match's local

mutants.name: ir-break-in-match
mutants.rule: A break inside a match leaves the loop: it names the loop's label, since Go's unlabelled break in the switch would leave only the switch (IRG3b)

mutants.name: ir-join-skipped
mutants.rule: A variant that a match or if expression yields into its union's local goes into the union

mutants.name: ir-match-scope-before-subject
mutants.from:
p = past(p, pre)
	// The subject is read once
mutants.rule: A match's switch opens after its subject's scopes (a catch subject's switch): DWARF scope positions must not decrease

mutants.name: irspike-unary-dropped
mutants.from: return &irExpr{K: "un", Pos: p, Op: op, X: b.expr(x.X)}
mutants.rule: An IR unary expression keeps its operator (! and -): the IR path prints what the source path prints. Only the generated programs hold a unary operator; the kernel has none.

mutants.name: irspike-ir-line-shifted
mutants.rule: An IR node carries its .ergo line, so the derivative reports an IR body that does not check at the source position.

mutants.name: irspike-ir-name-not-content
mutants.origin: wf10 batch-18 fix-tool (verify M2, the IR1 request's M5)
mutants.rule: The -ergoir flag, the one key of the IR in Go's build cache, names the IR file's content, not the module it was written in: an edit of the IR alone, in the same module, builds again (each seed of TestIRMatchesSource writes its own module, so only this test sees the difference).

mutants.rule: A match tree's type switch on a flat union takes each variant's case by its own tag

mutants.name: ir-tree-goto-dropped
mutants.from: return append(out, &irStmt{K: "goto", Pos: t.p, Label: label})
mutants.rule: A leaf of a shared arm jumps to the arm's block

mutants.name: ir-tree-shared-bind-dropped
mutants.from: out = append(out, &irStmt{K: "set", Pos: t.p, Local: l, X: e})
mutants.rule: A leaf of a shared arm sets the arm's bindings from its own values before its goto

mutants.name: ir-tree-default-dropped
mutants.from: sw.Cases = append(sw.Cases, &irCase{Pos: p, Def: true, Body: t.child(n.def, end)})
mutants.rule: A tree node's default branch holds the rows that test nothing in its column

mutants.name: ir-tree-scopes-unordered
mutants.rule: A match tree writes arms out of source order: its scope positions are moved up so the compiler's DWARF scopes never go back

mutants.name: ir-tree-const-case-first
mutants.rule: A match tree's constant switch takes each case by its own constant
